### Course Information

| Course Number | Course title                                   | Credit hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0401211       | Exegesis                                       | 3            |

**Prerequisites:**  
None

**Course description:**  
This course aims to give the student an idea about the principles of exegesis concerning the Qur'an in the principles of belief and their effect on the establishment of the society. The exegesis of Sections 29 and 30 is a requirement of the course, in addition to the meanings of certain vocabularies of the second half of the Qur'an.

---

| Course Number | Course title                                   | Credit hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0441213       | Mastering the Art of Reciting the Holy Qur'an (2) | 3            |

**Prerequisites:**  
(0431112)

**Course description:**  
This course provides in its second level the conceptual structure of the alphabetic letters and their qualities and the basic skills of reading the Holy Qur'an and perfecting its recitation through rooting, deepening and training on the subjects of the letters and their convergence towards: The concept of exits and the mechanism of the work of the speech apparatus in the production of Arabic letters and sounds, adjusting the exits of all Arabic letters, as well as making sure that the student's tongue is established and developing the skill of pronunciation of the letters of the Qur'an and ridding them of speech disorders, studying the qualities and their reflection in mastering the reading of the Holy Qur'an. The course also deals with the provisions of the meeting of letters and the consequences of the meeting of letters. The student is trained to recite the second ten parts of the Holy Quran 11-20 (from Surah Yunus to the end of Surah Al-Quran), memorize parts 17 and 18, with practical application of reciting the Holy Quran under the supervision and follow-up of the teacher, and reading the recitation parts to a certified sheikh.

| Course Number | Course title                                   | Credit hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0431222       | Analytic Hadith                                | 3            |

**Prerequisites:**  
None

**Course description:**  
This course aims to discuss certain accounts of the Prophet from different aspects such as: their meanings, ascriptions (chain), and words from the following books:  
- Sahih al-Bukhari with Fath al-Bari, 15 accounts from the following chapters: (Bad' al-Wahy, al-'Ilm, al-'Umrah and Khabar al-Ahad).  
- Sahih Muslim with Sharh al-Nawawi, 15 accounts from the following chapters: (al-Iman, al-Jihad wa al-Imarah, al-Libas wa al-Zinah and Sifat al-Munafiqin).
